t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Certain colours have higher point scores. This may change throughout the game and you may notice the originally high scoring colours score less points, at this point switch up game play and pick different colours.

vb_textbox.text: It is said that certain colours score higher points (+5 to +8) then this changes throughout the rounds slightly. I don't think this is always the case, if you pick a colour that scores highly, pick that colour until it starts to score lower. Usually the colours to pick from come in pairs e.g red and yellow. If yellow scores low, next go for red and it usually scores much higher.
